name: MEL1 Building 2 (phases 4-6)

lat.note: geocoded: centroid of OSM site polygon "AirTrunk MEL 1" (176 Swann Dr); campus-level point, not building 2 specifically

mw_it.note: aggregator figure (datacentermap, not re-fetchable: HTTP 429); AirTrunk says 'over 100MW of new IT load' (source 1, verified); campus total 185MW (Aug 2024). AirTrunk's Dec 2025 MEL2 release quotes MEL1 at 276MW+ (source 7)

cost_aud_m.note: 'over one billion-dollars of direct investment in Melbourne' over the next 18 months (source 1, verified; w.media: 'over AU$1 billion (US$665m)') — lower bound

jobs_construction.note: 'more than 1,000 jobs during the construction phase' (source 1, verified) — lower bound

jobs_operational.note: 'a significant number of new highly skilled technical and operational jobs in the Western Melbourne area' — no figure (source 1)

construction_start.note: announced 2024-08-09 (source 1); w.media (2024-08-21) reports AirTrunk 'has started on the expansion' following an announcement in June 2024

construction_end.note: 18-month delivery from Aug 2024 implies ~early 2026 (not recorded); Baxtel lists 'Year Built: 2023' and 'Fully operational with expansion in progress' (source 6) — 2023 likely refers to the earlier 20+MW phase; completion not confirmed by AirTrunk

open_questions: status: operational (datacentermap/Baxtel) not confirmed by AirTrunk; 18-month build from Aug 2024

location: a Jan 2021 photo (Flickr, source 8) captions 'AirTrunk data centre construction site at 210 Swann Drive' (4.5 ha site sold 2019, source 9) — Building 2 may be at 210 Swann Dr rather than 176; unverified
